title: CPL 2026 Live Streaming Guide: TV Channels by Country
description: Find where to watch CPL 2026 live in the USA, India, Pakistan, UK, Canada, Caribbean, Australia, Bangladesh, South Africa, UAE, New Zealand and Sri Lanka.
headline: CPL 2026 live streaming guide
lede: Check the confirmed TV channel or streaming service for your country before the opening match on 7 August. This guide separates announced coverage from markets where the 2026 broadcaster is still pending.

regions.name: USA
regions.access: Watch through Willow TV, willow.tv, the Willow by Cricbuzz apps or a participating US television provider.
regions.detail: Willow lists all 39 CPL 2026 matches from 7 August to 20 September. Subscription and provider-package requirements apply.
regions.time: A standard 7pm Caribbean start is 7pm ET. Jamaica matches at 7pm local begin at 8pm ET.

regions.name: India
regions.access: No CPL or broadcaster source currently confirms an Indian TV channel or streaming platform for the 2026 season.
regions.detail: Do not assume a previous-season platform still owns the rights. Check the official CPL news desk and the service schedule before subscribing.
regions.time: A standard 7pm Caribbean start is 4:30am IST the next day, or 5:30am for Jamaica fixtures.

regions.name: Pakistan
regions.access: No verified 2026 CPL television or streaming partner has been announced for Pakistan.
regions.detail: Check local sports schedules close to match day. A service carrying another cricket tournament does not automatically hold CPL rights.
regions.time: A standard 7pm Caribbean start is 4am PKT the next day, or 5am for Jamaica fixtures.

regions.name: United Kingdom
regions.access: A UK television channel or streaming service for CPL 2026 has not been confirmed by the tournament or a current rights holder.
regions.detail: UK viewers should wait for a dated 2026 listing. Historical CPL coverage does not confirm this season’s access.
regions.time: A standard 7pm Caribbean start is midnight BST, or 1am BST for Jamaica fixtures.

regions.name: Canada
regions.access: Canadian viewers can use Willow’s web and app subscription, subject to the current plan and match availability.
regions.detail: Willow serves the United States and Canada and lists the complete CPL 2026 tournament. Confirm the individual fixture before paying.
regions.time: A standard 7pm Caribbean start is 7pm ET. Jamaica matches at 7pm local begin at 8pm ET.

regions.name: Caribbean
regions.access: Rush Live & Louder is the confirmed television home of CPL 2026 across the Caribbean through listed cable and TV providers.
regions.detail: Provider, package and channel-number availability differ by island. Use the Rush directory to confirm the route in your territory.
regions.time: Match times on the CPL schedule use the host venue’s local clock. Jamaica is one hour behind most other host territories.

regions.name: Australia
regions.access: No current rights-holder schedule confirms CPL 2026 television or streaming coverage in Australia.
regions.detail: Previous Fox Cricket or Kayo arrangements should not be treated as current until a 2026 fixture appears in an official schedule.
regions.time: A standard 7pm Caribbean start is 9am AEST the next day, or 10am for Jamaica fixtures.

regions.name: Bangladesh
regions.access: No verified Bangladesh TV channel or streaming platform has announced CPL 2026 coverage.
regions.detail: Review local sports listings near the opening match and confirm that the exact CPL fixture appears before subscribing.
regions.time: A standard 7pm Caribbean start is 5am BST the next day, or 6am for Jamaica fixtures.

regions.name: South Africa
regions.access: No current CPL or broadcaster announcement confirms 2026 coverage in South Africa.
regions.detail: Check the sports schedule attached to your television package close to match day rather than relying on an older season’s rights list.
regions.time: A standard 7pm Caribbean start is 1am SAST the next day, or 2am for Jamaica fixtures.

regions.name: UAE & Middle East
regions.access: No verified CPL 2026 broadcaster or streaming service has been announced for the UAE and wider Middle East.
regions.detail: Confirm the exact event in your local platform’s schedule. Regional rights for other leagues do not establish CPL access.
regions.time: A standard 7pm Caribbean start is 3am GST the next day, or 4am for Jamaica fixtures.

regions.name: New Zealand
regions.access: No current rights-holder listing confirms CPL 2026 coverage in New Zealand.
regions.detail: Wait for a dated tournament or broadcaster announcement and check the individual match listing before buying access.
regions.time: A standard 7pm Caribbean start is 11am NZST the next day, or noon for Jamaica fixtures.

regions.name: Sri Lanka
regions.access: No verified Sri Lankan television or streaming partner currently lists CPL 2026.
regions.detail: Check local cricket schedules near the opening match. Only a current CPL listing confirms that a platform carries this season.
regions.time: A standard 7pm Caribbean start is 4:30am SLST the next day, or 5:30am for Jamaica fixtures.

faq.question: Where can I watch CPL 2026 live in the USA?
faq.answer: Willow by Cricbuzz lists all 39 CPL 2026 matches for viewers in the United States. Access is available through Willow TV, willow.tv, supported apps and participating television providers, subject to the selected package.

faq.question: Which channel shows CPL 2026 in the Caribbean?
faq.answer: Rush Live & Louder is the confirmed Caribbean television home for CPL 2026. Provider and package availability vary by territory, so use the Rush Where to Watch directory for the current local route.

faq.question: Where can I watch CPL 2026 in India?
faq.answer: A 2026 CPL broadcaster for India had not been announced as of 4 August 2026. Check official CPL news and the exact platform schedule before subscribing.

faq.question: Is CPL 2026 available free on YouTube?
faq.answer: CPL has not announced a free worldwide YouTube stream for every 2026 match. Official social channels may publish highlights, but highlights are not the same as a full live broadcast.

faq.question: Why are some countries marked pending?
faq.answer: A pending label means no dated 2026 announcement or current rights-holder schedule confirms coverage in that territory. The label prevents older broadcast deals from being presented as current.

faq.question: What time do CPL matches start in my country?
faq.answer: The official schedule uses each host venue’s local time. Most Caribbean host territories use UTC-4, while Jamaica uses UTC-5. Check the individual fixture because the tournament also includes morning and afternoon starts.
